brief:
Sudden gunfire sent children in Gaza into panic, Eye on Palestine reported. Intense fear and tears gripped youngsters in the streets as the shots rang out without warning, scattering families and sending residents scrambling for cover.

The incident occurred as Gaza remains under strain from armed tensions. Children were among those caught in public spaces when the gunfire erupted, forcing families to seek shelter and leaving young residents visibly distressed by the sudden violence in their neighborhoods.
